limitations: This is loop v2 / PR-6 deferred retrieval, not the 30 Sep critical path and not a warm-up generate/compile loop.
Lemma extraction is character-class regex plus bracket-depth on simp[/rw[/exact/apply; it does not parse Lean and may include local hypotheses (ih, Hinit) and field projections (hA.of_le).
Src lemmas are capped at 16 after uniquing; the other 14 JSONL proofs are always retrieved in full even when JSON views truncate statement/src to 400 characters.
No CorpusManifest, no Mathlib-scale lake ingest, no embeddings, and no Jev/TypeSafe call.
No lake compile, no Leanstral completion, no LOCK_EX, and no Arena scores, token-savings percentages, or official Track 1/Track 2 rankings were produced.
The implementation checkpoint directory may be unwritable on this host; coordinate checkpoints are best-effort.
